title: RigidBench: Evaluating Rigid-Body Physics in Video Generation Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.15555v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video models are increasingly used to predict what happens next in a scene, yet the metrics commonly used to compare their outputs say little about whether the predicted objects move correctly. Motion, geometry, identity, background stability, and visual similarity can fail independently, but whole-frame scores often mix these errors together. We introduce RigidBench, a simulator-grounded benchmark that compares a generated continuation with a reference rollout from the same initial frame and motion description. Its five rigid-body tasks vary objects, materials, viewpoints, and indoor and outdoor scenes, with per-frame masks, depth, 6-DoF trajectories, and contacts available for scoring. We evaluate eight models on the same 100 examples with ten measurements that keep these aspects separate. translated_title: RigidBench：评估视频生成模型中的刚体物理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15555v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：视频模型越来越多地被用于预测场景中接下来会发生什么，然而常用于比较其输出的指标很少说明预测对象是否运动正确。运动、几何、身份、背景稳定性和视觉相似性可能独立失败，但整体帧分数常常将这些错误混在一起。我们引入了RigidBench，一个基于模拟器的基准测试，它将生成的连续帧与来自相同初始帧和运动描述的参考滚动进行比较。其五个刚体任务涵盖了不同的物体、材料、视角以及室内外场景，并提供逐帧掩码、深度、六自由度轨迹和接触信息用于评分。我们在相同的100个示例上评估了八个模型，使用十种测量指标将这些方面分开。最终排名强烈依赖于测量内容：没有模型在所有十项中领先，且在各模型均值中，较高的SSIM伴随着较大的3D误差。
tldr: RigidBench是一个新的基准测试，通过分离运动、几何、身份、背景和视觉相似性等多个方面，揭示了视频生成模型在刚体物理预测中的性能排名依赖于具体测量指标，且没有模型在所有方面都表现最佳。
en_tdlr: RigidBench is a new benchmark that separates motion, geometry, identity, background, and visual similarity aspects, revealing that video generation model rankings depend heavily on the chosen metrics, with no model excelling across all ten measurements.
